productArea.name: Workflows
productArea.scope: Create, edit, test, activate, duplicate, and restore workflows, their triggers, actions, and forms, and browse workflow versions and runs. Records a workflow creates are checked only as its output; general record lists and settings are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Workflows to create a workflow or open one in the workflow editor.
Open Workflow Versions to filter, group, and restore versions or use one as a draft.
Open Workflow Runs to inspect run results.
